headline: Video of headmaster drinking and acting out in classroom goes viral
summary: The school official is facing a show-cause notice after a video showing him intoxicated intoxicated in a school setting became public.
details: A video has gone viral on social media showing a school headmaster drinking alcohol and behaving erratically in a classroom.
The footage captures the man in a state of intoxication, acting out within the school premises during school hours.
Following the public outcry and the spread of the video, authorities have issued a show-cause notice to the headmaster.
The incident has sparked widespread condemnation across social media platforms, with many calling for strict disciplinary action against the educator.
caption:
